story: Show a duplicated provider under its original at once and flash it, as an import's rows flash.
defect: AccountsSettingsViewController now keeps its own `providers: [Account]` copied once from AccountStore and maintains it by hand (insert on duplicate, append on import, remove on delete), feeds ProvidersSectionViewController from that copy alongside the store's $accounts sink, and resolves rows and taken names from it — a second source of truth that goes stale (e.g. after a sheet save) and fights the store's publish.
rule: macos/CLAUDE.md § Data down, events up — state lives in exactly one source of truth; the Controller invents no truth (only subscribes) and never mutates its own copy of store state
hit: Says AccountsSettingsViewController caches the provider list (a copy of AccountStore's accounts) and mutates that copy / feeds the section from it, instead of only subscribing to AccountStore — two sources of truth.
